bands.name: Deep layer (meniscofemoral + meniscotibial portions)

attachments.landmark_a: medial epicondyle, deep to the superficial layer
attachments.landmark_b: medial meniscus periphery and tibial plateau rim

bands.mechanical_role: secondary valgus restraint; anchors the medial meniscus's periphery to the capsule

bands.name: Fibular collateral ligament
bands.mechanical_role: primary restraint to varus stress at the knee

function: The knee's primary lateral (varus) stabilizer; part of the posterolateral corner complex together with the popliteus tendon and popliteofibular ligament.

bands.name: Patellar ligament
bands.mechanical_role: transmits quadriceps extensor force to the tibia; the patella functions as a sesamoid bone within this tendon-ligament continuum
bands.function_note: Terminologically a 'ligament' (bone-to-bone, patella-to-tibia) but functionally and developmentally the continuation of the quadriceps femoris tendon distal to the patella -- the patella itself is the largest sesamoid bone in the body, embedded within this single musculotendinous-ligamentous chain.
bands.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

function: The distal continuation of the quadriceps mechanism; a common autograft source (bone-patellar tendon-bone) for ACL reconstruction given its robust bone-to-bone attachments.
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
